ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace where independent LLM agents negotiate micro-services and settle payments instantly using BSV micropayments.
ideas.title: AgentEscrow BSV
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the BSV Blockchain Track and hits the core 'Agentic Payments' theme of the hackathon by implementing autonomous agent transactions.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge authentication system allowing AI agents to prove authorization limits and spending caps to payment gateways without revealing proprietary underlying keys.
ideas.title: ZK-Agent Auth Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering (ZK-proofs) with the agentic payments theme, mirroring winning ZK and agentic architectures from recent hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI validator agent powered by Claude that continuously audits and validates cross-chain agent transaction states before releasing on-chain funds.
ideas.title: BSV AVS Validator Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of combining advanced AI models with decentralized ledger verification to appeal to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time transaction monitoring and risk scoring engine designed specifically to screen autonomous agent wallets for illicit behavior before payment execution.
ideas.title: AgentGraph AML Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a proven award-winning security and compliance architecture specifically for the new domain of autonomous agent payments.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous trading bot platform where no-code AI agents autonomously execute arbitrage and execution strategies using instant BSV transaction channels.
ideas.title: ClashAgent BSV
ideas.why_it_could_win: Rebuilds a proven grand-prize-winning trading platform concept tailored directly to the sponsor's high-speed blockchain network.
